quotes.name: Goblin Grenadiers
quotes.flavor: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

quotes.name: Thunderscape Familiar
quotes.flavor: Thunderscape masters release familiars to help guide their apprentices down the thunderscape path.

quotes.name: Chainbreaker
quotes.flavor: Scarecrows deemed too malevolent to roam free are shackled to boulders or dolmen stones. Their animosity usually outlives the chains.

quotes.name: Prowling Pangolin
quotes.flavor: "Wait, are *we* the decoys?"

quotes.name: Congregate
quotes.flavor:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

quotes.name: Serra's Boon
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor:
"The light of an angel's glance is warm, but her fixed stare blinds and burns."
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra

quotes.name: Skyshroud Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"If it tastes one drop of elvish blood I will cast it from the shroud to see it burn."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Wizard's Retort
quotes.flavor:
"The second mage learned to dissipate blasts of lightning. Threat and response: thus did the study of magic progress."
—Naban, dean of iteration

quotes.name: Mistwalker
quotes.flavor:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore

quotes.name: Bronze Calendar
quotes.flavor: Every page holds a month, every date a numeral.

quotes.name: Sulfurous Springs
quotes.flavor: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

quotes.name: Firebreathing
quotes.flavor:
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

quotes.name: Temple of Deceit
quotes.flavor: Vault-Tec's vaults, rather than being the savior of humanity, were actually a series of unethical psychological experiments.

quotes.name: Treefolk Seedlings
quotes.flavor:
Even the grandest forest begins with a single seedling.
—Llanowar saying

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: They've got claws as long as your arm. And they're grouchy. Really, really grouchy.

quotes.name: Glint Hawk
quotes.flavor: Its eyes burned nearly blind by the Whitesun, it hunts by metallic gleam.

quotes.name: Miasmic Mummy
quotes.flavor: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Artifact Mutation
quotes.flavor:
"From shards and splinters I call forth my living horde."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Konstrari Annex
quotes.flavor: Battlemages of Konstrari, the school of constructive arts, pour their hearts into their craft in defense of Hexhaven.

quotes.name: In the Trenches
quotes.flavor: The battlefield became so pockmarked with craters and trenches that casualties were regularly attributed to "fell in a hole."

quotes.name: Gilraen, Dúnedain Protector
quotes.flavor: "Ónen i-Estel Edain, ú-chebin estel anim."

quotes.name: Night's Whisper
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

quotes.name: Sanctum Prelate
quotes.flavor: "These halls are sacred. You *will* be silent."

quotes.name: Mana Geyser
quotes.flavor: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

quotes.name: Soltari Priest
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is the test of gold; adversity, of strong men."
—Seneca, "On Providence," trans. Basore

quotes.name: Fury Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

quotes.name: Demolish
quotes.flavor: What took months for human hands to carve took just seconds for the dinosaur's tail to ruin.

quotes.name: Sylvan Scrying
quotes.flavor: One glimpse of an elf's home lasts her weeks away in the wild.

quotes.name: Mammoth Spider
quotes.flavor:
"If a careless elf ends up caught in a spider's web, we must expect nature to take its course. Do not blame the spider for being a spider."
—Dellin Berting, Tolarian entomologist

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Molten-Core Maestro
quotes.flavor: "My media? Fury and flame."

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

quotes.name: Sea Legs
quotes.flavor: "When the waves pick up, either you find your feet or you lose your lunch."

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: Back in the '80s, Channel 6 built their headquarters at the corner of Spectacle and Scandal.

quotes.name: Meteor Swarm
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Sometimes one fireball isn't enough.

quotes.name: A Realm Reborn
quotes.flavor: "The Seventh Astral Era is come!"

quotes.name: Elven Rite
quotes.flavor: As the bough stretches, so shall you grow. As the roots spread, so shall you thrive.

quotes.name: Summon Undead
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The air itself shuddered at the wizard's words, and from the dark beyond, her call was answered.

quotes.name: Utter End
quotes.flavor:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Hornbash Mentor
quotes.flavor: "We share the same nuanced opinion of hunters and military goons: smash them."

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

quotes.name: Miles Morales // Ultimate Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "You can't call yourself Spider-Man without taking a leap of faith. It's a lot to live up to. But I'm creating an all-new legacy."

quotes.name: Sure Strike
quotes.flavor: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."

quotes.name: Ruin-Lurker Bat
quotes.flavor:
"Look! Aclazotz sends his children to watch over our pilgrimage."
—Clavileño, First of the Blessed

quotes.name: Shipwreck Dowser
quotes.flavor: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

quotes.name: Mogg Salvage
quotes.flavor: Three moggs, one treasure, too bad.

quotes.name: Sigarda's Summons
quotes.flavor: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

quotes.name: Outmaneuver
quotes.flavor:
"Push one goblin into sight, an' run a lot. That's tactics."
—Jula, goblin raider

quotes.name: Murderous Compulsion
quotes.flavor: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

quotes.name: Brightstone Ritual
quotes.flavor: Wizards fought over the stone to exploit its power. Goblins fight over it because it's shiny.

quotes.name: Body of Research
quotes.flavor: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.

quotes.name: Reya Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: "As my light rises on the battlefield, my followers rise from it."

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Rugged Highlands
quotes.flavor: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.

quotes.name: Capture of Jingzhou
quotes.flavor: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

quotes.name: Knowledge Is Power
quotes.flavor: "Tremble, criminal, before the overwhelming might of meticulously organized evidence!"

quotes.name: Solemnity
quotes.flavor: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.

quotes.name: Sleight of Hand
quotes.flavor:
「敵を困惑させることは、武装解除させることに等しく効果的。」
――「生き残るためのトリックスターの指南書」

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "I would rather be a heretic than betray my conscience."

quotes.name: Captain Sisay
quotes.flavor: Sisay leads and the world follows.

quotes.name: Longbow Archer
quotes.flavor: Some say they have the blood of hawks running through their veins.

quotes.name: Primeval Titan
quotes.flavor: His silent stare was punctured only by his deafening roar.

quotes.name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

quotes.name: Aliban's Tower
quotes.flavor:
"Those who hide in hollow towers would do well to remember the rain."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

quotes.name: Shelter
quotes.flavor: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

quotes.name: Fiery Justice
quotes.flavor: When the rebels couldn't breach the castle to kill Lalor the Obstinate, they tried a more internal approach to depose the pretender king.

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor: Attacking a kami is considered bad luck, so seasoned mages have developed techniques to usher them back to the spirit realm without violence.

quotes.name: Tranquil Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Even the fiercest storm has a peaceful eye."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Vigor Mortis
quotes.flavor: After fear and weakness rot away, that which remains is stronger than its living form.

quotes.name: Rakdos Ickspitter
quotes.flavor:
"Our thrulls dissolve from the inside out in a matter of days. Shoddy work, but they're a scream while they last."
—Uzric, Rakdos guildmage

quotes.name: Exquisite Blood
quotes.flavor: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

quotes.name: Stranglehold
quotes.flavor: "Let's cook with fire, baby."

quotes.name: Urza's Mine
quotes.flavor: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor:
"Mystic shadow, bending near me, / Who art thou? / Whence come ye?"
—Stephen Crane, "Mystic shadow, bending near me"

quotes.name: Starlit Angel
quotes.flavor: To soar as high as hope, to dive as swift as justice.

quotes.name: Rain of Blades
quotes.flavor: Some say they are the weapons of heroes fallen in battle, eager for one last chance at glory.

quotes.name: Verduran Enchantress
quotes.flavor: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

quotes.name: Daggerclaw Imp
quotes.flavor: The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.

quotes.name: Byway Barterer
quotes.flavor: "This trinket has saved my hide more times than I can count. I couldn't possibly let it go for less than say . . . four acorns."

quotes.name: Generous Gift
quotes.flavor:
"Do I need a reason to want to help out a friend?"
—Sonic the Hedgehog

quotes.name: Vodalian Hypnotist
quotes.flavor: "Deceit is the heart of war."

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

quotes.name: False Mourning
quotes.flavor: Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other famous generals feigned their deaths in order to later surprise their opponents.

quotes.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
quotes.flavor: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

quotes.name: Banefire
quotes.flavor: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

quotes.name: Rite of Renewal
quotes.flavor: The greatest honor a Sultai can receive is to be returned to the realm of the living.

quotes.name: Erase (Not the Urza's Legacy One)
quotes.artist: Pete “Yes the Urza's Legacy One” Venters
quotes.flavor: Synonyms for "erase" we haven't used: ablate, a̶b̶r̶a̶d̶e̶, chafe, fray, f̶r̶a̶z̶z̶l̶e̶, scuff, and scrub.

quotes.name: Phantom Warrior
quotes.flavor: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Silent Departure
quotes.flavor: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

quotes.name: Bloodtithe Collector
quotes.flavor: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor:
"One need not always find peace on the sword's edge, my son. One can find peace as readily in helping things grow."
—Splinter

quotes.name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: Krotiq Nestguard
quotes.flavor: The bushwhacker's machete glanced off the root with a sickening crack. Slowly, the entire undergrowth turned to face him.

quotes.name: Pelakka Wurm
quotes.flavor: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

quotes.name: Infectious Inquiry
quotes.flavor: "I give you pain, you give me information. A simple trade, is it not?"

quotes.name: Nephalia Smuggler
quotes.flavor: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

quotes.name: Sarinth Greatwurm
quotes.flavor: It felt the rumblings of war and uncoiled itself from the depths of the world.

quotes.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
quotes.flavor: Soon, even her most adamant foes will call her . . . MOTHER!

quotes.name: Thrashing Brontodon
quotes.flavor: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

quotes.name: Noxious Dragon
quotes.flavor: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Jalum Tome
quotes.flavor: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

quotes.name: Dramatic Rescue
quotes.flavor:
"I never thought I'd be so glad to see two tons of beak and claws bearing down on me at the speed of an arrow."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

quotes.name: Kudo, King Among Bears
quotes.flavor: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

quotes.name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
quotes.flavor: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."

quotes.name: Tanglewalker
quotes.flavor: In bringing life to Mirrodin, Memnarch was more successful than he knew—for Mirrodin began to take on a life of its own.

quotes.name: Depower
quotes.flavor: "WAIT . . . I feel funny . . . something's not right."

quotes.name: Soul Snare
quotes.flavor:
"Shackle the body, and the anguish lasts only until death. Shackle the soul, and the wicked can be punished for eternity."
—Inquisitor Laerin

quotes.name: Volcanic Rambler
quotes.flavor: It moves through lava with the force of an erupting volcano.

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Multiversal Passage
quotes.flavor: New worlds await...

quotes.name: Hardened Scales
quotes.flavor:
"They're herbivores, not prey animals. Go startle one if you want to know the difference."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Leap
quotes.flavor: Mirri leapt quickly and silently. The guard died likewise.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
quotes.flavor:
"Even after death, a wealth of serviceable biomass remains."
—Phyrexian progress notes

quotes.name: Legion Conquistador
quotes.flavor: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

quotes.name: Voracious Tome-Skimmer
quotes.flavor: She spoils the book before you read it.

quotes.name: Nurturing Peatland
quotes.flavor: New life is born within its shadows.

quotes.name: Armorcraft Judge
quotes.flavor: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

quotes.name: Dragonscale General
quotes.flavor: "Dragons seek war. I bring it to them."

quotes.name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
quotes.flavor:
"Death does not prevent us from service to our absent master. As long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall we."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Recurring Nightmare
quotes.flavor:
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Obelisk of Grixis
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Pestilent Cauldron // Restorative Burst
quotes.flavor: "Death? Everyone does death. Let me show you something actually impressive."

quotes.name: Atarka, World Render
quotes.flavor:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

quotes.name: Ignoble Soldier
quotes.flavor: Cowardice is a term invented by those with no cunning.

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

quotes.name: Hexplate Golem
quotes.flavor:
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

quotes.name: Lymph Sliver
quotes.flavor: Its skin remains in a flowing, liquid state that keeps its body coated with potent restorative lymph.

quotes.name: Oji, the Exquisite Blade
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: They walk the Path of Kensei with perfect balance.

quotes.name: Fabrication Module
quotes.flavor: Inspiration leads to design.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Tombstone, Career Criminal
quotes.flavor: "I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."

quotes.name: Force of Negation
quotes.flavor: "Try, if you must."

quotes.name: Ultimate Alliance
quotes.flavor:
"When you said 'no man can equal you'? You had to know that was just begging for Jen to hit you."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

quotes.name: Discord, Lord of Disharmony
quotes.flavor: "Oh, what fun is there in making sense?"

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Only one loyal subject did not fear the wrath of the Marchioness—her beloved "Fluffin."

quotes.name: Mana Drain
quotes.flavor: "I suppose you've never heard of conservation of energy."

quotes.name: Griffin Protector
quotes.flavor: The drums of war stir the hearts of all who fight for righteousness.

quotes.name: Blightspeaker
quotes.flavor: One croaked sermon spreads propaganda and plague.

quotes.name: Legion Leadership // Legion Stronghold
quotes.flavor:
"The firemane angels are mighty, but their greatest value lies in the fervor their presence kindles in the heart of a soldier."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Winter Moon
quotes.flavor:
"The sun and moon have decided to make a competition of our misery."
—Naromin, veteran explorer

quotes.name: Gathering Place
quotes.flavor:
"Will your friends be staying the night, Master Stark?"
—Edwin Jarvis, Avengers Mansion butler

quotes.name: Juzám Djinn
quotes.flavor: "Expect my visit when the darkness comes. The night I think is best for hiding all." —Ouallada

quotes.name: Whalebone Glider
quotes.flavor:
"It's no ornithopter, but then I'm no Urza."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

quotes.name: Artificer's Hex
quotes.flavor:
"Some treasures aren't worth finding, let alone stealing."
—Dack Fayden

quotes.name: Delraich
quotes.flavor: It wears the souls of its victims like jewels on a chain.

quotes.name: Fate Forgotten
quotes.flavor: When Sarkhan saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, it changed Tarkir's future. The Sultai no longer exist, having been supplanted by the dragonlord Silumgar and his clan.

quotes.name: New Generation's Technique
quotes.flavor: April's Turtle tots: Moja, Odyn, Uno, and Yi.

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.flavor: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

quotes.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
quotes.flavor: "Heheheharr . . . awrr . . . uhuhuhuheh . . . ha-HA ha-HA!"

quotes.name: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin
quotes.flavor: "I suppose this is my fate as a dark knight. Soon, I won't even feel remorse for my actions."

quotes.name: Spineless Thug
quotes.flavor: What it lacks in backbone, it makes up for in cruelty.

quotes.name: Skullscorch
quotes.flavor:
"A good whack on the head usually has the same effect."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Poultrygeist
quotes.flavor: Farmer Brown never ate eggs again.

quotes.name: Biomechan Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Life is a pattern, not a material."

quotes.name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
quotes.flavor: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

quotes.name: Magus of the Abyss
quotes.flavor: He climbs a staircase of falling souls, fighting the continuous pull of the void.

quotes.name: Serra Advocate
quotes.flavor: An angel's blessing prepares a soldier for war better than a thousand military drills.

quotes.name: You're Ambushed on the Road
quotes.flavor: "Hand over your loot and no one gets hurt!"

quotes.name: Borderland Marauder
quotes.flavor: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

quotes.name: Retraction Helix
quotes.flavor: Where the geometries of the world collapse, a master of the Æther can harvest power beyond comprehending.

quotes.name: Cloak of Mists
quotes.flavor: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

quotes.name: Timberland Ancient
quotes.flavor: Only the trees were old enough to remember what happened when Moag ignored warnings of Phyrexia millennia ago. They were determined not to repeat the mistake.

quotes.name: Nessian Boar
quotes.flavor: Renata led the best hunters in all of Theros on a quest to bring down the terror of the Setessan wilds.

quotes.name: Gutter Skulker // Gutter Shortcut
quotes.flavor: Some people take that as inspiration.

quotes.name: Thrun, the Last Troll
quotes.flavor:
*Thrun_TheLastTroll:* new acct can't keep me banned
*Thrun_TheLastTroll:* i rule

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.flavor: Before the elf queen will aid you, you must find a way to cure the strange rot afflicting the roots of the ancient trees.

quotes.name: Blaze
quotes.flavor: Fire never dies alone.

quotes.name: Nessian Hornbeetle
quotes.flavor:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

quotes.name: Feral Prowler
quotes.flavor: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.

quotes.name: Pariah's Shield
quotes.flavor: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

quotes.name: Kalastria Nightwatch
quotes.flavor:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: Lone Wolf
quotes.flavor: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

quotes.name: Another Round
quotes.flavor: Weary travelers trade stories of the Eversaloon, an extraplanar respite that appears at the moment it is most needed.

quotes.name: Blockade Runner
quotes.flavor: "I need to get back to Mercadia City," said Sisay. "We can get you there," the vizier answered. "Easily."

quotes.name: Siege-Gang Commander
quotes.flavor: They began to throw missiles that passed right above the battlement and fell thudding within the first circle of the City.

quotes.name: Peer into the Abyss
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity."
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Clash of Wills
quotes.flavor: Alhammarret rose to his feet, and the full force of his mind hit Jace like a storm front.

quotes.name: Marsh Threader
quotes.flavor: "Give me a sturdy rope over the advice of any so-called expert. I can thread the dark wilds better than anyone."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Walker
quotes.flavor:
"I have heard terrible tales of black rains, ashen fields, and metal that screams. I have consoled myself that the tales were a myth of some fevered mind. But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth."
—Kasib Ibn Naji, Letters

quotes.name: Civic Saber
quotes.flavor: Those without a guild signet often display a different form of protection.

quotes.name: Elven Fortress
quotes.flavor:
"The size of the obvious Fortress walls often misled foes. Actually, the Elves enchanted the forest itself to provide the first line of defense with tangling vines and stinging thorns."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

quotes.name: Abzan Falconer
quotes.flavor: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

quotes.name: Bond of Agony
quotes.flavor: The Rakdos are unique in designing torture equipment they can operate while "suffering" alongside their victims.

quotes.name: Decision Paralysis
quotes.flavor:
"Eyes see only what is possible. A trained mind can explore the impossible."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

quotes.name: Arcum's Sleigh
quotes.flavor:
"With the proper equipment and caution, one can travel anywhere."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Mistrise Village
quotes.flavor: Built on a fumarole field, the village is a refuge of warmth amid the ice of the Qal Sisma mountains.

quotes.name: Sworn Companions
quotes.flavor:
"The trouble with youths these days is that, in outright defiance of their elders, they refuse to be bought."
—Karlov of the Ghost Council

quotes.name: Lightning-Core Excavator
quotes.flavor:
"That's the third time this month it's exploded on site. Maybe we should switch to something a little less defective."
—Kerrin, archaeologist

quotes.name: Masako the Humorless
quotes.flavor: Konda's servants dared not neglect their duties for a moment under Masako's icy gaze, knowing that what she saw, Lord Konda would hear.

quotes.name: James, Wandering Dad // Follow Him
quotes.flavor: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

quotes.name: Benjamin Sisko, Besieged
quotes.flavor: "If we're going to lose, then we're going to go down fighting, so that when our descendants someday rise up against the Dominion, they'll know what they're made of!"

quotes.name: Submerged Boneyard
quotes.flavor: Aether currents in the sky mirror water currents below, including the deadly rapids.

quotes.name: Rushwood Dryad
quotes.flavor: To a dryad, every tree in the forest is both a doorway and a window.

quotes.name: Runed Servitor
quotes.flavor: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

quotes.name: Wrath of Marit Lage
quotes.flavor:
"Marit Lage lies frozen in a glacier's heart. Still her dreams take form in our world, stealing the heat from our souls."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Soul Partition
quotes.flavor: Teferi's body couldn't travel through time far enough, but with Kaya's help, his spirit could.

quotes.name: Leyline Dowser
quotes.flavor:
"Of course it works. What does it find? That's a surprise for a lucky buyer like yourself."
—Honest Rutstein

quotes.name: Doomskar Oracle
quotes.flavor: "Giants and monsters loom on the horizon, and the elves plan to murder our gods!"

quotes.name: Epitaph Golem
quotes.flavor: Many names and many memories bound together in grim purpose.

quotes.name: Entrancing Melody
quotes.flavor: The stronger the will, the more bewitching the song.

quotes.name: Rite of Harmony
quotes.flavor: Nature bends to the witches' call.

quotes.name: Voracious Greatshark
quotes.flavor: There is no boat big enough.

quotes.name: Nef-Crop Entangler
quotes.flavor: "If you do not feel the thrill of battle, alive like a flame, you will never triumph."

quotes.name: Seedship Broodtender
quotes.flavor: "Inspiration blossoms from fertile rot."

quotes.name: Leather Armor
quotes.flavor: Lightweight, flexible, and protective.

quotes.name: Ant Queen
quotes.flavor:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

quotes.name: Divine Visitation
quotes.flavor: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

quotes.name: Cut a Deal
quotes.flavor:
"A strong Eorzea will ever have need of a strong Ul'dah."
—Nanamo Ul Namo

quotes.name: River's Rebuke
quotes.flavor: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

quotes.name: Duh
quotes.flavor: Will players understand that the creature is being crushed by two parentheses? Not a chance.

quotes.name: Practical Research
quotes.flavor: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way. Will hit the library. Rowan hit everything else.

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

quotes.name: Sliversmith
quotes.flavor: After centuries of labor, its creations outnumber those they were to mimic.

quotes.name: Tendrils of Corruption
quotes.flavor: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

quotes.name: Blow Your House Down
quotes.flavor:
"You think these walls will protect you? My, you have a dim view of the power of the wilds."
—Marawen, barrow witch

quotes.name: Ground Assault
quotes.flavor:
"Taking down a dragon is easy. All you need is enough space to get in a good swing."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

quotes.name: Circuit Mender
quotes.flavor: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

quotes.name: Kitchen Finks
quotes.flavor: Accept one favor from an ouphe, and you're doomed to accept another.

quotes.name: Deranged Assistant
quotes.flavor: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

quotes.name: Immolation
quotes.flavor: Nothing is funnier to a devil than setting someone—anyone—on fire.

quotes.name: Wind Strider
quotes.flavor: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

quotes.name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around. Just don't stare at the nightkin."

quotes.name: Futurist Forge
quotes.flavor:
"You saw what I built in a cave. Imagine what I can do here."
—Tony Stark

quotes.name: Southern Elephant
quotes.flavor: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

quotes.name: Tinker
quotes.flavor: "What separates us from mere beasts is the capacity for self-improvement."

quotes.name: Stitch in Time
quotes.flavor: Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.

quotes.name: Grim Monolith
quotes.flavor: Part prison, part home.

quotes.name: Simic Charm
quotes.flavor:
"We measure our progress in heartbeats."
—Prime Speaker Zegana

quotes.name: Felidar Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Kneel before her Impurrial Meowjesty, Pawlina von Whiskerface III. It makes it much easier to give her pets.

quotes.name: Vandalize
quotes.flavor:
"As we have learned from Kolaghan, to ruin is to rule."
—Shensu, Kolaghan rider

quotes.name: Shantotto, Tactician Magician
quotes.flavor: "Ohohoho! I might be the harshest mistress in all of Vana'diel. But I may yet forgive you, if at my feet you kneel."

quotes.name: Raise the Alarm
quotes.flavor: The city of Drannith danced to the music of the siege. Four bells meant a breach of the north wall. A horn blast meant all hands to arms. Additional gongs and tones indicated fire, poison, air raids, and more.

quotes.name: Giant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Only the most effective tactics stand the test of time."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

quotes.name: Seething Song
quotes.flavor: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

quotes.name: Terra Stomper
quotes.flavor: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

quotes.name: Durable Coilbug
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

quotes.name: Vineglimmer Snarl
quotes.flavor:
"It has strange properties, a Metebelis crystal. It can affect the mind."
—The Third Doctor

quotes.name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
quotes.flavor: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

quotes.name: Caged Zombie
quotes.flavor: "Six consecutive life sentences" takes on a new meaning when necromancy is involved.

quotes.name: Grotag Siege-Runner
quotes.flavor:
"I don't think he's bringing in the mail . . . ."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

quotes.name: Sudden Demise
quotes.flavor: In the Skyfang Mountains, one misstep can mean the end of an entire clan.

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: "My family protects all families."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Protean Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

quotes.name: Furygale Flocking
quotes.flavor: Seek inspiration at your own risk.

quotes.name: Mystic Monastery
quotes.flavor: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

quotes.name: Angelheart Vial
quotes.flavor: It holds a whisper from Iona: "Persevere."

quotes.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
quotes.flavor: Like her well of stories, Birgi's horn never runs dry.

quotes.name: Brotherhood Vertibird
quotes.flavor: As tough as the armored troops it carries.

quotes.name: Sanguine Bond
quotes.flavor: "Careful, I bite."

quotes.name: Clever Impersonator
quotes.flavor:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

quotes.name: No Rest for the Wicked
quotes.flavor:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

quotes.name: Plague Sliver
quotes.flavor: A sliver shares everything with its hive—even its afflictions.

quotes.name: Mistform Ultimus
quotes.flavor: It may wear your face, but its mind is its own.

quotes.name: Teferi's Realm
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is dead. Water has killed him."
—From *The Stories of Nature*

quotes.name: Hurkyl's Recall
quotes.flavor: This spell, like many attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife Hurkyl.

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

quotes.name: Ember Beast
quotes.flavor:
Spot one ember beast, attack.
Spot a second, best fall back.
—Dwarven saying

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Militant Inquisitor
quotes.flavor: "I am an instrument of the church wielded against Avacyn's enemies."

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Ticketomaton
quotes.flavor:
"Please do not engage in debates on the nature of reality with the robot staff."
—Astrotorium sign

quotes.name: Get a Life
quotes.flavor: Gimme five! (Or whatever you got.)

quotes.name: Fang of Shigeki
quotes.flavor:
"Let me give you a taste of the poison you've poured into our land."
—Shigeki, founder of the Order of Jukai

quotes.name: Bloodrock Cyclops
quotes.flavor:
"He's big an' dumb an' ready to fight. A lot like ol' Hornhead here."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

quotes.name: Darksteel Axe
quotes.flavor: Heavier than it looks, tricky to wield, guaranteed to last.

quotes.name: It That Heralds the End
quotes.flavor:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Carnival Hellsteed
quotes.flavor: Its favorite treats are candied hands and sweet hearts.

quotes.name: Citywide Bust
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Banishing Knack
quotes.flavor: Suddenly he realized that everything was connected by invisible strings, strings that could be pulled—or cut.

quotes.name: Battlefield Forge
quotes.flavor:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Territorial Scythecat
quotes.flavor: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

quotes.name: Pygmy Razorback
quotes.flavor: As a rite of passage, Kipamu youths taunt razorbacks with long sticks . . . then flee.

quotes.name: Noose Constrictor
quotes.flavor:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: Bloodshot Trainee
quotes.flavor: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"

quotes.name: Carnivorous Plant
quotes.flavor:
"It had a mouth like that of a great beast, and gnashed its teeth as it strained to reach us. I am thankful it possessed no means of locomotion."
—Vervamon the Elder

quotes.name: Talruum Champion
quotes.flavor: In the Talruum language, there is no word for "surprised."

quotes.name: Wildheart Invoker
quotes.flavor:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Scorching Spear
quotes.flavor: Lift your spear as you might lift your glass, and toast your enemy.

quotes.name: Ashnod's Coupon
quotes.flavor: Limited time offer. Void where prohibited. Limit one per purchase. Valid only in participating duels. This coupon is nontransferable and invalid if shattered, crumbled, detonated, pillaged, or otherwise disenchanted. Cash value less than 1/20 of a cent. Offer not valid in Quebec, Rhode Island, or where prohibited by law or the DCI.

quotes.name: Giant Adephage
quotes.flavor:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

quotes.name: Rewind
quotes.flavor: "The best denials are simply that: a beginning and end unchanged, a dream with no memory."

quotes.name: Take Up the Shield
quotes.flavor: The frontier was an anvil on which many an unlikely hero would be forged.

quotes.name: Pestermite
quotes.flavor: The fae know when they're not wanted. That's precisely why they show up.

quotes.name: Stromgald Cabal
quotes.flavor: When the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of easy victories, its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

quotes.name: Rip Apart
quotes.flavor: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

quotes.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
quotes.flavor: "I think you'll find my terms quite agreeable, if you know what's good for you."

quotes.name: Deeproot Pilgrimage
quotes.flavor: "These glyphs are more than trail markings! They tell a story as they go. But does it end in celebration or tragedy?"

quotes.name: Horned Turtle
quotes.flavor: It doesn't like having visitors . . . unless it's having them for lunch.

quotes.name: Clear Shot
quotes.flavor: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

quotes.name: Tribal Flames
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Squallmonger
quotes.flavor: "Squall, gale, hurricane—it's all a matter of size . . . and price."

quotes.name: Bloodtithe Collector
quotes.flavor: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

quotes.name: Psychosis Crawler
quotes.flavor:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

quotes.name: Ever-Watching Threshold
quotes.flavor:
"You think they know we're here?"
—Orlo, goblin raider

quotes.name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
quotes.flavor:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

quotes.name: Sly Spy
quotes.flavor: The Agents of S.N.E.A.K.—Spies Nimbly Eluding Adversaries' Knives.

quotes.name: Valakut Awakening // Valakut Stoneforge
quotes.flavor:
"I can hear the echo of their hammers, long stilled."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic

quotes.name: Dihada's Ploy
quotes.flavor: The last piece was finally in place.

quotes.name: High Fae Trickster
quotes.flavor: "You humans think even slower than you move. You don't realize you've already lost."

quotes.name: Pulse of the Grid
quotes.flavor: Before labs or lectures, there was insight.

quotes.name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
quotes.flavor:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: A reminder of the day's adventure, and a shiny plaything.

quotes.name: Multani's Decree
quotes.flavor:
"This is my place of power. Nothing can take root here unless I allow it."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Arbor Armament
quotes.flavor:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

quotes.name: Pair o' Dice Lost
quotes.flavor: The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.

quotes.name: Mysterious Pathlighter
quotes.flavor: For good or ill, most fae can't resist meddling in the adventures of any knight they meet.

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: "Ah-noo wee-tee kah wah-tees."

quotes.name: Broken Wings
quotes.flavor: Getting airborne with a kitesail is easy. It's everything afterward that takes focus, skill, and luck.

quotes.name: Veilborn Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Liliana's voice carries far, reaching beyond the cold pall of death.

quotes.name: Selfless Savior
quotes.flavor: She raised him from an orphaned pup and gave him a life of love. With his last act, he thanked her.

quotes.name: Knight of the Skyward Eye
quotes.flavor: La Orden del Ojo Celeste, sin saberlo, sigue la voluntad de una fuerza maligna, extendiendo la desconfianza y el miedo por todo Bant de acuerdo a sus planes.

quotes.name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
quotes.flavor: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects: the creative sun, the sustaining sun, and the destructive sun.

quotes.name: Teller of Tales
quotes.flavor: Words never uttered by mortals flowed incessantly from its many mouths.

quotes.name: Elenda, Saint of Dusk
quotes.flavor: "You have learned nothing in my absence."

quotes.name: Spear Spewer
quotes.flavor:
"Don't waste time aiming, you lazy gob-slug! Fire!"
—Krenko, mob boss

quotes.name: Evolution Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.

quotes.name: Voyager Quickwelder
quotes.flavor: The Guidelight Voyagers had been stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home. They considered every last unit essential, down to the glitchiest grunt.

quotes.name: Brion Stoutarm
quotes.flavor: "I just want you to feel you're doing well. I hate for people to die embarrassed."

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

quotes.name: Meanders Guide
quotes.flavor: In the silence of the Dark Meanders, she thought only of those still lost.

quotes.name: Tremor
quotes.flavor: One little goblin shook up the ground. When the dust cleared, no one was found.

quotes.name: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass
quotes.flavor:
The Champion armed herself to face the cyclops, heedless of her companions' despair. "How will you defeat it with only one spear?" asked young Althemone. The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Soul Warden
quotes.flavor: The group called the Benefactors offers what aid and protection it can to other survivors, marking precious safe zones with the sign of the flame.

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

quotes.name: Fungusaur
quotes.flavor: Rather than sheltering her young, the female fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

quotes.name: Claustrophobia
quotes.flavor: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

quotes.name: Conclave Naturalists
quotes.flavor: "Your swords and wards have no power here."

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: When she flies above the good, they consider themselves blessed. When she flies above the wicked, they consider themselves dead.

quotes.name: Dalek Squadron
quotes.flavor: "Find the Doctor! Seek, locate, destroy!"

quotes.name: Brass Squire
quotes.flavor:
"I admire it. Few pull off pluck and subservience at the same time."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

quotes.name: Harmonic Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Nighthowl Pursuer
quotes.flavor: "What shall we do?" cried Bilbo. "Escaping Goblins to be caught by wolves!"

quotes.name: Diversion Unit
quotes.flavor: "Declarative: Goodbye."

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

quotes.name: Shadow of the Enemy
quotes.flavor: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly. His wrath blazed in consuming flame, but his fear rose like black smoke.

quotes.name: Ringsight
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Frodo was able to see beneath their black wrappings. In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes.

quotes.name: Warped Landscape
quotes.flavor: Each cryptolith twists the plane's mana, bending its flow to a singular purpose.

quotes.name: Soulmender
quotes.flavor: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

quotes.name: Bloodsworn Steward
quotes.flavor: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Rampant Elephant
quotes.flavor: No matter how righteous the cause, it helps to bring along some muscle.

quotes.name: Wall of Air
quotes.flavor: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

quotes.name: Fallowsage
quotes.flavor: Memories of ages past are said to swim the minds of lounging fallowsages.

quotes.name: Stony Silence
quotes.flavor: The relic's purpose? Its design? Whatever the intent, it is now a mere curiosity that breaks up the horizon.

quotes.name: Grapple with the Past
quotes.flavor: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

quotes.name: Faithful Pikemaster
quotes.flavor: "I seek no fight with you, but neither will I stand aside."

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Knight-Captain of Eos
quotes.flavor: The strength of Bant's caste system is the unfailing loyalty of its meekest members.

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

quotes.name: Beckon Apparition
quotes.flavor: When a graveyard is full, the gwyllions rattle the tombs and unleash the spirits into the sky.

quotes.name: Purple Dragon Punks
quotes.flavor:
"These guys are young, but no rookies. They've fought and beat everything on two legs in this area . . . except us."
—Leonardo

quotes.name: Demonic Tutor
quotes.flavor: Beware the generosity of demons.

quotes.name: Machine God's Effigy
quotes.flavor: Gix ensured his most loyal followers were the first to taste Phyrexian perfection.

quotes.name: Savage Surge
quotes.flavor: Gruul warriors never need to be stirred to battle. They need only to be shown where the battle is.

quotes.name: Elder Cathar
quotes.flavor: "My greatest hope is that you will surpass me in every way, consigning my name to some forgotten corner of history."

quotes.name: Colorful Feiyi Sparrow
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: These nimble sparrows, not often seen, delight in tricking the pangolins that wander the forest.

quotes.name: Unruly Mob
quotes.flavor: "We survived the Travails! Killer angels! Horrors from beyond the moon! Now some big werewolves think they can scare us? Let 'em try."

quotes.name: Homeward Path
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

quotes.name: Bloodcurdling Scream
quotes.flavor:
"I have all the weapons my enemies have—and far deeper rage."
—Tojira, swamp queen

quotes.name: James, Wandering Dad // Follow Him
quotes.flavor: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

quotes.name: Dark Maze
quotes.flavor:
"Stray not into the path of darkness, or be lost forever."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: "Catch!"

quotes.name: Elvish Champion
quotes.flavor:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

quotes.name: Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful
quotes.flavor: Day after day he sat there, knowing that the Wanderer would soon be back for him.

quotes.name: Living End
quotes.flavor:
"Mortality is a gift. There is a comfort in knowing that the end is coming."
—*Vess's Cautions in Necromancy*

quotes.name: Roiling Dragonstorm
quotes.flavor: In every biome of Tarkir, the storms spew forth dragons well suited to dominate.

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Secret Tunnel
quotes.flavor:
"I forget the next couple of lines, but then it goes...'Secret tunnel! Secret tunnel!"
—Chong, nomad musician

quotes.name: Steelclad Serpent
quotes.flavor:
"From the highest towers to the deepest sea, all life must be touched by etherium."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

quotes.name: Dauntless Dismantler
quotes.flavor: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

quotes.name: Greater Good
quotes.flavor:
"We have more sprouts than they have hands."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

quotes.name: Rodeo Pyromancers
quotes.flavor:
"My citizens throw good money at them, and for what? Cheap tricks and collateral damage. Damnable Slickshot charlatans."
—Baron Bertram Graywater

quotes.name: Scion of the Swarm
quotes.flavor: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.

quotes.name: Overgrown Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

quotes.name: Joven and Chandler
quotes.flavor: Thicker than thieves.

quotes.name: Battlefield Butcher
quotes.flavor: "Any more giant metal monsters want to try their luck? I'm just getting warmed up!"

quotes.name: Meandering River
quotes.flavor: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

quotes.name: Inspiring Unicorn
quotes.flavor: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.

quotes.name: Fool's Tome
quotes.flavor: Squee: "What's that?" Ertai: "It's a magical book." Squee: "Am I smart enough ta use it?" Ertai: "You could say that."

quotes.name: Undiscovered Paradise
quotes.flavor: Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.

quotes.name: Leyline Immersion
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: When Nissa tapped into Zhalfir's leylines, she was shocked to feel not a piece of Dominaria, but a plane all its own.

quotes.name: Brightclimb Pathway // Grimclimb Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"Why risk life and limb exploring the wilds? For this."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Elvish Eulogist
quotes.flavor: "No matter how adept our artistic skill, our effigies can never hope to capture the vibrant beauty of a living elf. Perhaps that is truly why we mourn."

quotes.name: Underrealm Lich
quotes.flavor: "You've strayed, overworlder."

quotes.name: Sliver Overlord
quotes.flavor: The end of evolution.

quotes.name: Blue Elemental Blast
quotes.flavor: "Contrary to popular wisdom, I find it's best to fight fire with its opposite."

quotes.name: Spiteful Sliver
quotes.flavor: Victories against the hive are tragedies.

quotes.name: Elanor Gardner
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Her father Samwise gave her the Red Book for safekeeping before he sailed into the West.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Altar
quotes.flavor:
"Unskin these impure bodies, Great Yawgmoth, that the flesh may welcome your blessings."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

quotes.name: Earthshaker
quotes.flavor: It scaled the Sokenzan Mountains in search of Kumano's secret. The mountain shook for two days, and the kami never returned.

quotes.name: Tajuru Stalwart
quotes.flavor: "In its time of hardship, all of Zendikar cries out in pain. Are you listening?"

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Valor Made Real
quotes.flavor: "As my father taught, 'Training will raise your shield to the blow, but courage fills the gaps the shield leaves open.'"

quotes.name: Solemn Recruit
quotes.flavor: "I can no longer sit in my workshop and ignore the events outside. My hammers strike for the people of Ghirapur."

quotes.name: Prizefighter Construct
quotes.flavor: The Scrappers, an underground group with a passion for automaton brawls, had renegade leanings even before the Consulate's crackdown. It didn't take long for them to lend their best brawlers to the conflict.

quotes.name: Laccolith Warrior
quotes.flavor: The screams are brief. The silence lingers.

quotes.name: Cruel Sadist
quotes.flavor:
Face of innocence. Hand of death.
Designed by Edmund McMillen

quotes.name: Bladestitched Skaab
quotes.flavor: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.

quotes.name: Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes
quotes.flavor: For some, making a better world means mending bodies while pretending to never see faces.

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: Toolcraft Exemplar
quotes.flavor: "If you wish to produce the finest work, you must start with the finest tools."

quotes.name: Gray Ogre
quotes.flavor: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

quotes.name: Call of the Conclave
quotes.flavor: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

quotes.name: Plague Beetle
quotes.flavor: No one knows whether they were named for the disease they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Patriarch's Bidding
quotes.flavor:
"Family plots are so convenient."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Gaea's Protector
quotes.flavor: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

quotes.name: Manaplasm
quotes.flavor: Urak froze when he heard it. That was his first mistake. He turned and cast a dramatic ward spell. That was his last.

quotes.name: Flames of the Firebrand
quotes.flavor:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Diamond Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, rainbows follow.

quotes.name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
quotes.flavor: "I order you to volunteer."

quotes.name: Daggermaw Megalodon
quotes.flavor: Valgavoth's evil aura turned the shark from an apex predator into an inescapable terror of the deeps.

quotes.name: Change of Fortune
quotes.flavor:
"We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking."
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

quotes.name: Rumbling Baloth
quotes.flavor: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.

quotes.name: Kindred Summons
quotes.flavor: Bring your friends, your friends' friends, and their friends too.

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Grizzled Outcasts // Krallenhorde Wantons
quotes.flavor: Seen as unsavory, the hunters were never allowed in town—until one night they vanished.

quotes.name: Golgari Charm
quotes.flavor:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

quotes.name: Sandstorm Charger
quotes.flavor:
"May our foes choke upon its horns!"
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: How Is This a Par Three?!
quotes.flavor: Against the infinite backdrop of space, isn't all golf miniature?

quotes.name: Boomerang
quotes.flavor:
"O! call back yesterday, bid time return."
—William Shakespeare, *King Richard the Second*

quotes.name: Captain America, Team Leader
quotes.flavor: "Avengers assemble!"

quotes.name: Gilt-Leaf Palace
quotes.flavor: Dawn's Light, greatest palace of Gilt-Leaf Wood, is built on tiers of wood and power.

quotes.name: Pewter Golem
quotes.flavor: Centuries before the first chimneys of Mephidross belched clouds of toxic gas, only the golems' movements stirred the air of Mirrodin.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Negator
quotes.flavor: They exist to cease.

quotes.name: Stifle
quotes.flavor:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

quotes.name: Volo, Guide to Monsters
quotes.flavor: "The beholder told me I had a good eye for details. Who was I to argue?"

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

quotes.name: Endless Cockroaches
quotes.flavor: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.

quotes.name: Trostani, Three Whispers
quotes.flavor: Tangled in the heart of Vitu-Ghazi, they guard their secrets from eager ears.

quotes.name: Arcane Sanctum
quotes.flavor:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

quotes.name: Lagonna-Band Storyteller
quotes.flavor: "Our stories are full of ancient wisdom; they tell us who we are."

quotes.name: Pardic Arsonist
quotes.flavor: Otaria's epidemic of insanity didn't affect certain barbarians—but no one noticed.

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor: "I don't *feel* any different."

quotes.name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
quotes.flavor: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor:
"My observations of the Multiverse are too valuable not to preserve for posterity."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Sage Owl
quotes.flavor: The owl asks but never answers.

quotes.name: Lookout's Dispersal
quotes.flavor: Her song plucks the strings of the storm, shifting wind and storm into a harmony that will carry her ship to safety.

quotes.name: Moroii
quotes.flavor:
"Touched by moroii"
—Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"

quotes.name: Tactical Officer
quotes.flavor: "Kouassi to bridge. Captain, the intruders look like Starfleet, but their combadge is different. It's . . . a dagger through a planet?"

quotes.name: Jayemdae Tome
quotes.flavor: A true scribe devotes an entire lifetime to the creation of a single volume, a masterpiece as unique as its maker.

quotes.name: Fungusaur
quotes.flavor: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

quotes.name: Catacomb Crocodile
quotes.flavor:
"I am sewer-king!" said Rat. "I am quick and cunning and I know every tunnel."
"No, I am king!" said Zombie. "I am cold and deadly and no rot can harm me."
Then Croc came and ate them both.

quotes.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
quotes.flavor: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

quotes.name: Nearby Planet
quotes.flavor:
"Here's a nice place we haven't hit yet."
—Captain Rex Nebula

quotes.name: Panacea
quotes.flavor: A drop numbs the tongue. A sip sends the heart racing. A draught reforges the body.

quotes.name: Fireblast
quotes.flavor: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

quotes.name: Hide in Plain Sight
quotes.flavor: The trees look beautiful... until they look back.

quotes.name: Oblivion Ring
quotes.flavor: A circle of sugar and a word of forbiddance.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Cruel Tutor
quotes.flavor: The more you pay for the lesson, the better you'll remember it.

quotes.name: Primal Plasma
quotes.flavor: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table. There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice *now*!"
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
quotes.flavor: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

quotes.name: Esper Panorama
quotes.flavor: Esper is an expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

quotes.name: Navigation Orb
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Travel the world without ever leaving the comfort of home.

quotes.name: Transguild Courier
quotes.flavor: Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.

quotes.name: Benalish Marshal
quotes.flavor:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—*History of Benalia*

quotes.name: Jerrard of the Closed Fist
quotes.flavor: Once, the order of the Closed Fist reached throughout the Kb'Briann Highlands. Now, Jerrard alone remains to uphold their standard.

quotes.name: Uncivil Unrest
quotes.flavor: The mob had only one rule: Never stop dancing.

quotes.name: Atomic Microsizer
quotes.flavor: When packing for a stealth mission, it's important to fold your dimensions tightly.

quotes.name: Flooded Woodlands
quotes.flavor: Freyalise's tears bring life and renewal, though they also bring trouble.

quotes.name: Power Conduit
quotes.flavor: Never content, vedalken artificers continually tinker with their creations.

quotes.name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
quotes.flavor: She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Forces
quotes.flavor: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

quotes.name: Dark Confidant
quotes.flavor: Greatness, at any cost.

quotes.name: Chandra's Fury
quotes.flavor: "They started it."

quotes.name: Taxi Driver
quotes.flavor: "I got two speeds, buddy: fast and off duty."

quotes.name: Hunger of the Howlpack
quotes.flavor:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Jump
quotes.flavor:
"Humanity has always envied the power of flight. So we took it."
—Scytha, aeromage

quotes.name: Pestilent Wolf
quotes.flavor: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: Gallows Warden
quotes.flavor: The spirit cares nothing for the crimes or triumphs of the slain. It shelters all beneath its stormy cloak.

quotes.name: Enlightened Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

quotes.name: War Room
quotes.flavor:
"We stand at a crossroads, Doctor, quite alone, with our backs to the wall."
—Winston Churchill

quotes.name: Warbeast of Gorgoroth
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Drums rolled, fires leaped, and great engines drawn by beasts crawled across the field.

quotes.name: Feral Invocation
quotes.flavor: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

quotes.name: Claustrophobia
quotes.flavor: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Bounce Chamber
quotes.flavor: Anti-gravity. Pro-fun.

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

quotes.name: Incandescent Aria
quotes.flavor: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute. When the room fell silent, she was surrounded only by rose petals falling gently to the floor.

note: Real flavor texts from the MTGJSON card corpus. Unfiltered view is a daily-stable random sample; search to reach the full corpus.
